reason: While the Hebrew text does contain a statement from God indicating His rejection of Judah and withdrawal of His presence (וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה גַּם אֶת־ יְהוּדָה אָסִיר וּמָאַסְתִּי אֶת־ הָעִיר הַזֹּאת - 'And the Lord said: I will also remove Judah from My presence... and I will reject this city'), this passage demonstrates God's rejection and removal of the people rather than any consideration of replacing them with another people. The text shows divine judgment and removal, but does not contain language suggesting replacement with a different nation or people.
